snippet.title: Cryptward Online — Trailer Oficial
snippet.description:
Enter the crypt. Come back with the loot.

Cryptward is an online first-person dungeon RPG set in a voxel world built block by block. Make a character, pick a vocation and go down into the crypts, alone or in a party, for experience, loot and ever more dangerous creatures.

🗝️ Open beta coming soon on Steam · Free to play
🌐 Website: https://cryptward.online

⚔️ Four vocations: warrior, archer, mage and druid
🔥 Spells, sword, axe, shield and bow
🏰 Crypts generated on every descent, with bosses and loot
🍺 A town and a tavern with other players, NPCs and shops
💰 Sell and trade items with other players
🌎 In English, Portuguese and Spanish

A Taverna Games game.

#Cryptward #RPG #IndieGame
